INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY — MOCK EXAM #6
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Work alone with eyes closed

2. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. International Cricket Team
   B. Information and Communication Technology
   C. Input Cable Tester
   D. Internal Cooking Timer

3. When learning Digital Citizenship, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Digital Citizenship.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Digital Citizenship.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Digital Citizenship.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Digital Citizenship.

4. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. CPU
   C. Keyboard
   D. Monitor

5. When learning Artificial Intelligence, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Artificial Intelligence.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Artificial Intelligence.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Artificial Intelligence.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Artificial Intelligence.

6. When learning Graphic Design, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Graphic Design.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Graphic Design.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Graphic Design.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Graphic Design.

7. When learning Audial- Visual Creation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Audial- Visual Creation.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Audial- Visual Creation.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Audial- Visual Creation.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Audial- Visual Creation.

8. When learning Robotics, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Robotics.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Robotics.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Robotics.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Robotics.

9. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

10. When learning Emerging Trends in ICT, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Emerging Trends in ICT.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Emerging Trends in ICT.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Emerging Trends in ICT.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Emerging Trends in ICT.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
11. In three clear sentences, explain Audial- Visual Creation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Digital Citizenship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Emerging Trends in ICT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Artificial Intelligence and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Robotics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Graphic Design and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Audial- Visual Creation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Digital Citizenship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
